# Attribution and source licenses

Ali Romman prepared this construction with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, implementation, separate adversarial checks, and writing. The internal checks belong to the author process. New material is under Apache License 2.0. [License](LICENSE) · [Coordination](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7847) · [Earlier campaign](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7794)

- Leo Bluestein supplied the chirp reduction of a Fourier transform to a linear filter. Spectral diagonalization of a circulant, the principal square root off a cut, Schur complements and the elementary inclusion-exclusion inequalities are classical. Anatoly Karatsuba and Yuri Ofman supplied the short-word multiplication method. The earlier physical polynomial-product package also used a Karatsuba word engine. [Bluestein’s paper](https://doi.org/10.1109/TAU.1970.1162132) · [Karatsuba and Ofman’s paper](https://www.mathnet.ru/eng/dan26729) · [Physical ring predecessor](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/research/physical-ring-product/README.md)
- Jose Manuel supplied the exact rational full recursive circuit and its joint prefix bounds. Vlado Vojdanovski supplied the underlying bounded-displacement recursion, tensor routing and shear words. Chafik Boukhalfa supplied the certified phase algorithm. The exact Stein producer keeps its separate provenance. James Reed’s and the physical-cut audits have the scopes stated in the sources. [Original gate PR](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4205) · [Full circuit proof and author credit](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7ab1bc8973cc9e606053c65f094ca3abc4a42fee/research/rational-unitary-fft/FULL-PROOF.md) · [Displacement recursion](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1673) · [Phase contribution](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/628) · [Stein source and license](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/research/rational-unitary-fft/vendor/STEIN-PROVENANCE.json)
- Cinna Davis supplied the balanced original-coordinate CRT and complete caller. Hiroki KUMAZAKI and the reservoir, omission and two-width control contributors retain their predecessor credits. The new arbitrary-width decoder uses the same modular-rotation networks. [Balanced CRT PR](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4100) · [Source attribution](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/research/unconditional-batched-crt/NOTICE.md) · [Mixed-width predecessors](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/research/crt-mixed-width-caller/README.md)

[Finite cyclic DFT](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/d13f23b723b8a846827a245b89c10fc7d3f11612/Mathlib/Analysis/Fourier/ZMod.lean) · [Public decoder](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/343f7b1817e26ad3f89d2ddad313b12741d53602/research/mixed-rank-uniform-composition/lean/PublicGrid.lean)

The new work connects branch selection to physical low-displacement compilation, including the two-boundary rank proof, the fixed matched-gate reduction, the heterogeneous coprime-square controller, the exact CRT character, and the multiplications and general joint filters that use them. The working files and source hashes identify the retained code. [Source bindings](SOURCES.json)
